detections.name: Urania
detections.note: A known asteroid. Each frame is centred on where its orbit predicts it to be. The circle follows the brightest spot near the centre, found in 12 of 17 frames. The few pixels between the prediction and that spot come from the timing of the prediction, not from the asteroid.

notes: Each frame is centred on where the asteroid was predicted to be on that date, so the asteroid stays in the middle and the background stars change.
The team dataset labels this object “moving”. The label has not been checked scientifically.
